whatThisPluginAdds.text: AI Orchestrator provides a shared capability registry, governed execution path, generation history, and request queue for AI features owned by other Capell packages.

surfaceOutcome.text: Admins can inspect registered capability metadata in the capability catalog. Consuming packages keep ownership of their editor actions and approval screens.

developers.text: Packages implement AIOrchestratorModule and register typed capabilities, while RunAIOrchestratorCapabilityAction enforces runnable actions, authorization, and policy guardrails in one place.

teams.text: AI-assisted features across Capell share the same registration, approval, execution, and recording boundaries instead of behaving differently in each package.
